name: Daily Payment Summary selects and clears all visible payments
description:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
2. Select the header checkbox for the visible payment rows.
3. Confirm every visible row is selected and the bulk actions appear.
4. Clear the header checkbox and confirm the row selection and bulk actions are cleared.
